name: Quiet Sage
direction: Quiet Sage original warm charcoal, muted sage and cream identity with current Nothing Island, eyes,44px top groups,54px bottom dock and all existing music/application features.

typography.verification: Font availability checked; final actual-scale readability pending

geometry.panel_position: top menu / clock island / corner status; bottom dock
geometry.panel_groups: top left menu then workspace indicator; center clock/date island; right status; bottom centered launchers/running apps only
geometry.composition: Preserve live Nothing Island and eyes, top-left menu/workspaces, right status and bottom programs-only dock.

materials.texture: none on controls or text surfaces
materials.wallpaper: Quiet warmcharcoal field with subtle small centered supplied Apple/LM silhouette in muted sage; no wood, metal or medallion.

artwork.instruction: Reuse exact approved Quiet Sage wallpaper/menu logo; never regenerate or overwrite original artwork.

preserve: fastfetch short and fastfetch long; plain fastfetch stays short
widget close, Escape, focus return and library reopen behavior
approved Plum Afterglow assets and recovery receipts
verification: Build, selection, visual, interaction and reboot evidence recorded separately. No live changes in identity phase.

semantic_rules.borders: control_border for essential input edges; border only decorative
semantic_rules.rainbow: Legacy field name retained for six green/gray/teal identity bands; no rainbow colors.
semantic_rules.ansi_black: ANSI slot 0 is readable gray; inspect applications that use it as background
semantic_rules.alerts: Original Quiet Sage semantic ANSI colors are retained; decorative identity is muted sage and cream.
